title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Durchsuchungsmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität

extraction.summaryEn: Police searched four properties in Kreuzberg and Neukölln over a weapons law violation, seizing a loaded pistol, ammunition and an alarm/signal weapon. Four suspects aged 19 to 35 are being investigated.
